title: Edge sessionization and async enrichment pipeline for low-latency structured-log ingestion
creator: Sofia Martinez
description:
Problem: High-cardinality, partially-ordered structured logs from edge services make it hard to correlate causal sessions and compute session-level latency/error metrics. Current ingest adds enrichment and correlation downstream which increases tail latency and causes duplicate/misaligned correlation IDs across Loki and ELK sinks.

Goal: Implement an edge-side lightweight sessionization and async enrichment pipeline that groups related events into session frames (partial sessions) before fanout, provides deterministic correlation ID canonicalization, and performs non-blocking enrichment (tenant resolution, service name normalization, geo/ip lookup) so that downstream aggregators (Loki/ELK) receive coherent session-aware records with stable correlation mapping. The pipeline must be idempotent, backpressure-aware, and support dynamic schema inference to avoid schema drift during gradual rollout.
acceptance_criteria: Edge agent groups events into partial sessions with session_id and session_seq for >90% of incoming flows for sampled tenants
Canonical correlation_id is applied and preserved across Loki and ELK fans out with <0.1% mismatch rate (measured by log joiner test)
Async enrichment pipeline completes for >=95% of events within 500ms without blocking event acknowledgment to upstream services
System supports schema evolution: test workload with new optional fields should not break downstream parsers (Loki and ELK) during rollout
Backpressure behavior: when downstream is slow, edge agent drops non-critical enrichment work and marks records with enrichment_state=degraded; no loss of primary log payloads
End-to-end dashboards show session reassembly rate, enrichment latency p50/p95/p99, dropped-enrichment ratio, and correlation mismatch rate
Canary rollout for 5 internal tenants, followed by gradual ramp to 50% of traffic with automatic rollback on >1% increase in session-mismatch or >10% eject rate
tasks: Design: session frame format (session_id, session_seq, partial_end, ttl_ms) and idempotent write protocol
Implement: edge agent sessionizer (Rust) + local cache for partial sessions with eviction policy
Implement: async enrichment worker with batched lookups (tenant mapping, service name mapping, geo/ip) and a result cache
Implement: canonicalization service for correlation_id (deterministic hashing + tenant namespace) and SDK shim for languages
Integrate: fanout adapter to Loki and ELK ensuring consistent fields and tags; add topic-level metadata for reassembly
Observability: tracing hooks for session lifecycle, metrics for enrichment latency, and Grafana dashboard panels
Testing: unit tests, integration test harness that replays shuffled event streams and asserts session reassembly & parity
Canary: rollout plan and automated rollback playbook; smoke-tests and load-run for 95th percentile latency validation
Docs: API contract for session fields, SDK changes, and runbook for handling 'enrichment_state=degraded'
